compiled_state.title: As a gov-copy-writer agent, I can query USWDS, GOV.UK, and VA.gov plain-language rules from the gov-copy corpus (Foundation slice)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Populate the gov-copy domain partition of the UI/UX reference corpus with federal plain-language and copy-editing rules from three foundation sources: USWDS forms copy guidelines, GOV.UK error/form patterns and Service Manual writing guidance, and VA.gov Content Style Guide.

**Why**: SC-8 requires federal-style-canon entries for government UI copy editing. This Foundation slice covers the three highest-precedence sources (USWDS, GOV.UK, VA.gov). Required by depending epic f360-3a5b-b8f3-4f86 (gov-copy-writer sub-agent). Depends on 9fee-6947 (corpus infrastructure) and cfa6-6c7f (integration test suite — precision sub-test for USWDS form validation).

**Scope**:
- IN: gov-copy domain Markdown files for: USWDS forms copy; GOV.UK error/form patterns + Service Manual writing guidance; VA.gov Content Style Guide (error anatomy, capitalization, punctuation)
- OUT: 18F Plain Language, FPLG, CDC (covered by edbb-67aa Enhancement slice)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the gov-copy domain contains >=3 source partitions covering USWDS forms copy, GOV.UK error/form/Service-Manual patterns, and VA.gov Content Style Guide; each entry has domain: gov-copy, a stable rule_id, prior_art citation, and precedence field; Summary + Detail tiers required
  <- Satisfies: sc-8

- When this story is complete, VA.gov entries cover error anatomy, capitalization, punctuation, and writing-for-gov principles
  <- Satisfies: sc-8

- When this story is complete, GOV.UK entries cover error message patterns (error-summary, inline error, copy standards) and Service Manual writing guidance
  <- Satisfies: sc-8

- When this story is complete, USWDS entries cover form label copy, helper text, error message standards, button labels, placeholder text
  <- Satisfies: sc-8

- When this story is complete, all entries are schema-valid; check-corpus-schema.sh passes; _index.yaml updated
  <- Satisfies: sc-1, sc-2

- When this story is complete, ref-query.sh gov-copy 'form error message' returns >=1 result
  <- Satisfies: sc-8, sc-3

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked.
